test.create_query: CREATE TABLE array_join_relaxed_filter (id UInt64, A Array(String), B Array(String), C Array(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO array_join_relaxed_filter SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> concat('a', toString(number % 10), '_', toString(x)), range(number % 30)), arrayMap(x -> concat('b', toString(number % 10), '_', toString(x)), range(number % 29)), arrayMap(x -> concat('c', toString(number % 10), '_', toString(x)), range(number % 31)) FROM numbers(20000)
test.query: SELECT arrayJoin(A) AS a, arrayJoin(B) AS b, arrayJoin(C) AS c, count() FROM array_join_relaxed_filter WHERE (a = 'a2_5' AND b = 'b2_1' AND c = 'c2_3') OR (a = 'a7_5' AND b = 'b7_2' AND c = 'c7_9') GROUP BY a, b, c FORMAT Null

SELECT a, b, c, count() FROM array_join_relaxed_filter ARRAY JOIN A AS a ARRAY JOIN B AS b ARRAY JOIN C AS c WHERE (a = 'a2_5' AND b = 'b2_1' AND c = 'c2_3') OR (a = 'a7_5' AND b = 'b7_2' AND c = 'c7_9') GROUP BY a, b, c FORMAT Null

SELECT a, b, c, count() FROM array_join_relaxed_filter ARRAY JOIN A AS a ARRAY JOIN B AS b ARRAY JOIN C AS c WHERE (a != 'a2_5' AND b != 'b2_1' AND c = 'c2_3') OR (a != 'a7_5' AND b != 'b7_2' AND c = 'c7_9') GROUP BY a, b, c FORMAT Null
